description: Enumerate spec clauses for navigation, across `core` / `js-api` / `web-api` (set `spec`). Filter by source `path` (core: `intro`, `syntax`, `valid`, `exec`, `binary`, `text`, `appendix`, or sub-paths like `syntax/types`), `anchor_prefix`, `titled_only`, and `max_level`. Returns lightweight rows {id, anchors, title, level, path, url}; follow up with section_get.

anchor_prefix.description: Filter to clauses whose id/anchor starts with this prefix, e.g. `syntax-`, `valid-`, `exec-`.

max_level.description: Cap heading depth (1 = page titles only). Anchor-only blocks are unaffected.

path.description: Filter to a source path / prefix. Top-level areas: `intro`, `syntax` (structure), `valid` (validation), `exec` (execution), `binary`, `text`, `appendix`. Sub-paths like `syntax/types` also work.

spec.description: Which WebAssembly spec to query: `core` (default; instructions, types, validation, execution, formats), `js-api` (JavaScript embedding), or `web-api` (Web platform integration).

titled_only.description: Drop anchor-only content blocks (keep only clauses with a heading).

version.description: WebAssembly spec version to query. `latest` (default) is the current served version; `main` is the upstream working draft.

name: section_list
title: List spec sections
